title: Percutaneous Versus EUS FNAC in Pancreatic Masses
brief_summary: We aim to evaluate the role of Ultrasound-guided (USG) fine needle aspiration cytology (FNAC) in diagnosis of pancreatic masses compared to endoscopic ultrasound (EUS) guided fine needle aspiration cytology (FNAC).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 50 Patients in different sex \& age groups with pancreatic masses

Exclusion Criteria:

* Any general contraindications for FNAC or EUS in some cases as Coagulopathy with INR \>1.5 or platelet count \<50,000/mmc, Antithrombotic therapy.
